data.why: The repository ships complete, protocol-matched bench-reading demo CSVs (one per assay, data/demo/) and a verified calculated-results table (data/examples/provided_results.csv); the app also loads these itself by default, so copies are only needed for testing the upload path.

goals: Load the built-in example data and review calculated results for a cottonseed study (phenolics, flavonoids, DPPH, FRAP, minerals) with replicate statistics and Tukey letters
Upload raw bench readings (absorbance, titre, or mass) for a chosen assay and get a calculated result table with QC flags
Check a standard curve's R² and flag samples that read outside the calibration range so they know to dilute and re-read
Identify replicates with excessive CV and see which specific reading deviates, to know what to recheck in the notebook
Compare samples within the same assay using ANOVA/Tukey compact letter display
Export an auditable Excel report with per-replicate values, summary statistics, and plots

review.summary: The tree follows the README's workflow well. Its best tasks (calibration, out-of-range dilution, replicate CV culprit, non-detects, IC50, Tukey letters, target flags) are backed by screens that show what they claim, including three tasks the replay wrongly failed to confirm. It needs fixes before filing: titration, gravimetric, qualitative and Codex comparisons are reduced to a single tour task, method/calibration settings are missing, and a few citations (066, 045, 060) don't show what the nodes say.
